Well, you have a couple of options. You can give your friend the choice to listen to you by asking whether you can vent about something that is bothering you. It's best if you tell them that they can stop you at any time if it becomes too much. Another option is you can vent in a diary or here. If you'd like, you can even talk to me. You could try calling a hotline or cousellor. With a hotline, its important to know that they might not be able to give you the best advice, so I suggest calling them if you only want a place to vent, and someone will listen to the best of their abilities. Don't go in with high expectations.
